# Friendly [Attitude]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Social Interaction](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#FriendlyAttitude)*

A Friendly creature views you favorably. You have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md) on an ability check to influence a Friendly creature. *See also* "[Influence](../Combat/Actions/Influence.md)."
